data.title: 黍 · 起晚了也给你留着早饭
data.description: 家中厨房里，黍穿麦黄围裙与青绿棉裙，端着还温热的粥碗走向你。她微笑示意你坐下，桌上小菜和另一副碗筷都已摆好；灶上的锅盖半开，柔和晨光照在金色手部与围裙口袋上。
data.action: 稳稳端着粥碗走向镜头，示意你入座
data.mood: 熟悉踏实的照顾与包容
data.promptProse: Breakfast has stayed warm for you. Shu carries the porridge bowl toward the viewer with a reassuring smile and a small nod toward the ready seat. Side dishes and the second bowl are already on the table; a pot lid remains slightly open at the stove. Morning light picks out her golden hands and the deep pocket of the wheat-yellow apron over the green cotton dress.
